messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "mouth-related effects begin within minutes of a dose"
set: ["mouth-related effects begin within minutes of a dose", "mouth-related effects", "most mouth-related effects resolve within an hour", "use the mixture within 15 minutes", "within about 1 hour of first dose", "throw away if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing", "if child vomits within 30 minutes after taking, take another dose", "get new bottle if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing", "not a complete list of side effects", "effects are dose related", "within a few hours to a day", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC", "potassium level via blood test within a week of starting or changing dose", "these effects are not a sign of addiction", "first dose infused over 15 minutes", "hormonal effects of medicine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
